ablage.aufraeumen_frage: Go through everything in the inbox once and file it?\n\nIt only moves mail where you have filed it yourself. Nothing is reported. Every move is listed in the journal afterwards and can be undone one by one.
ablage.aufraeumen_hilfe: In normal operation it only looks at new mail. Whatever already sits in the inbox it has never touched — “Tidy” does that once. It reports nothing while doing so; every move is listed in the journal below and can be undone.
ablage.schwaechen: Where your filing wobbles ({a} ambiguous, {b} nearly empty, {c} empty)
ablage.schwaechen_hilfe: That is not a fault, it is the raw material for later: senders you have filed sometimes here, sometimes there — for those the mail stays put, to be safe.
ablage.titel: Your filing — this is what it learns from
ablage.wie: It puts new mail exactly where you have already put mail from that sender — and nowhere else. It invents no destination and creates no folder. Learned: {zeit}.

heimat.hilfe: These write to you again and again — and for them there is no folder. That, not some over-cautious threshold, is where sorting fails: it can only imitate, and where you have never filed anything there is nothing to imitate. One click and it sits for good.

ki.hilfe:
When mail fits into no drawer, a language model can propose rules. It sorts nothing — you are the one who accepts.
🔴 Only the sender, name, subject and the reason leave this machine. Never the text of a mail, never an attachment.
ki.hilfe.anthropic: Sender and subject go to Anthropic. Costs per request.
ki.hilfe.aus: The watchman decides on its own. Unclear mail waits on this page.
ki.hilfe.ollama: Runs on your own hardware. Nothing leaves the house.
ki.hilfe.openai: Sender and subject go to OpenAI. Costs per request.
ki.hilfe.werkstatt: Puts the cases in a folder your own agent picks them up from.
ki.lokal.einrichten_hilfe: Don't have one yet? The setup installs Ollama, pulls a model and fills the address in here. Download and double-click it — on the machine the model should run on, not here.
ki.lokal.hilfe: A model on a machine of your own. Nothing leaves the house, and nothing costs anything. If you already have one, the Postwache finds it by itself.
ki.lokal.hinweise: On first launch macOS asks first (right-click → Open) and Windows shows SmartScreen (“More info” → “Run anyway”). The setup speaks English.
ki.lokal.nichts: No model found — neither at the Postwache nor on your machine.
ki.lokal.titel: A local model — in one click
ki.lokal.warnung: If the model runs on a different machine than the Postwache, Ollama has to listen on the network — anyone on that network can then use it, Ollama has no password. The setup asks before it does that.
leer.text: The Postwache looks at nothing as long as no mailbox is set up. It takes a minute.

u.baum.hilfe: Every number is measured: that many mails end up in this folder.
u.hilfe: Three stages, separate and in this order: read (read-only), plan (does not touch the mailbox), run (moves mail). Nothing is ever deleted — every move is journalled and reversible.
u.kein_journal: No journal — nothing has been moved yet.
u.kein_plan: There is no plan. Compute one first.
u.laeuft_schon: Something is already running. Please wait.
u.rest.hilfe: This mail goes to “Unsorted”. Anyone appearing often here deserves a rule.
u.selbst: Sort new mail on its own
u.sicher: Really move now? Nothing is deleted, and “Undo everything” reverses every move.
u.sicher_ordner: Really remove empty folders? Only folders WITHOUT mail that the reorganisation emptied are removed. Folders that were already empty stay — you created those. Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Trash and Spam are never touched.
u.still: No sign of life for {dauer} — this may be a network blip. Every step can be repeated.
u.wortschatz: Vocabulary from your own folders: {kategorien} categories, {woerter} words

z.baum.hilfe: This is how the plan distributes the mail at B — the same rules as the restructuring.
z.hilfe: Six stages, in this order: check · plan · transfer (nothing at A is touched) · compare · empty A (separate release) · redirect. There is no moving between two providers — every mail is read and created anew. That is why nothing is deleted at A until it is provably present at B.
z.laeuft_schon: A stage is already running. Wait for it.
z.sicher_leeren: Mail at A will now be DELETED. Only mails whose Message-Id was verified live at B. This cannot be undone. Continue?
z.sicher_uebertragen: Transfer now. Nothing at A is touched — only created at B. Continue?
z.umleitung.hilfe: Postwache picks up new mail at A, files it at B and only then clears it at A. This is not a provider-side forward — Postwache could neither sort nor verify one.
z.umleitung.loeschen: delete at A once confirmed at B
z.umleitung.ziel_posteingang: into the inbox — the watch at B sorts, reports and hands over documents
z.umleitung.ziel_sortiert: sorted straight away — only sensible if no watch runs at B
